{{Top|canon=Gyro stabilizer}}
A '''gyroscopic stabilizer''', also known as a '''gyro-stabilizer''', was a system of [[Wikipedia:gyroscope|gyroscopes]], hydraulics and high-speed processors that improved the stability of droids. It was also a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component that monitored the ship's pitch and yaw, and modified its [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|artificial gravity]] to keep its contents upright.

[[Mitrinomon Transports/Legends|Mitrinomon Transports']] [[Z-6 jetpack/Legends|Z-6 jetpack]] incorporated a gyro-stabilizer in its design, which automatically applied counterthrust during landing.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
